title: EGB Circulation V1 Parallel-Implementation Compatibility Map
status: STRUCTURED_INTERFERENCE; no equivalence is asserted without a declared operational role

role_scoped_correspondences.roundtrip_defect: The right schema splits more response coordinates and includes explicit accepted contexts, licensed collapses, forbidden transports, and future obligations. The left schema is simpler and already installed in the Library claim graph.
role_scoped_correspondences.decision: retain left node as canonical ID; treat right fields as optional profile refinement

role_scoped_correspondences.roundtrip_defect: Collapsing event and update into one loop loses the distinction between an observed response and a successfully persisted field mutation; expanding the loop requires an event/update boundary.
role_scoped_correspondences.decision: keep one canonical loop node and retain event/update as schema phases, not duplicate claims

role_scoped_correspondences.roundtrip_defect: The left implementation records six explicit separators and the independent-index experiment. The right implementation provides a layer-by-coordinate matrix but no canonical separator IDs.
role_scoped_correspondences.decision: keep left claim node; attach the matrix as evidence/profile data

role_scoped_correspondences.roundtrip_defect: Structural node/edge/frontier counts are only some coordinates of the vector gain object and cannot recover proof-path, translation, mechanization, external-validation, or resource effects.
role_scoped_correspondences.decision: retain vector-valued gain; record structural counts as exact subcoordinates

role_scoped_correspondences.role: prove the circulation layer changes research performance
role_scoped_correspondences.roundtrip_defect: No substantive difference after scope normalization.
role_scoped_correspondences.decision: use OPEN.CIRCULATION_BENCHMARK as canonical node ID

role_scoped_correspondences.roundtrip_defect: The twelve-profile view separately exposes descent, identity, translation, and circulation; the nine-jewel view intentionally fuses some of these for routing. No final partition is warranted.
role_scoped_correspondences.decision: retain both as views; profile partitions are probes, not ontology

role_scoped_correspondences.roundtrip_defect: The Library engine is stronger on event validation and writeback reports; the independent engine is stronger on optical graph inspection. Neither subsumes the other.
role_scoped_correspondences.decision: extend one runtime with both operation families after benchmark, not by unreviewed code merge

separators_exposed.distinction: illumination response versus persisted field mutation
separators_exposed.consequence: A response can be mathematically good yet fail to close the Braid if no typed writeback occurs.

separators_exposed.distinction: nine routing jewels versus twelve finer response profiles
separators_exposed.consequence: Jewel partitions are task-relative views, not one final ontology.

separators_exposed.distinction: node/edge counts versus vector-valued future transformation gain
separators_exposed.consequence: Exact structural deltas are evidence coordinates, not a total value measure.

separators_exposed.distinction: validating an event versus generating/inspecting an illumination
separators_exposed.consequence: A complete runtime needs both source-governed validation and optical comparison operations.

separators_exposed.distinction: independent implementations with overlapping purpose but different decomposition
separators_exposed.consequence: Do not silently deduplicate; compare by role and preserve round-trip defects.

forbidden: claiming the two implementations are mathematically equivalent without an operational role
creating duplicate canonical claim nodes for the same benchmark frontier
averaging the two jewel partitions into a supposedly final ontology
